items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Three Smith brothers, Luke Smith, Russell Smith -

ctx.x: Three Smith brothers, Luke Smith, Russell Smith -

Yeah, I get all mixed up, yeah. Smith brothers, all three of them playin' trumpet - one playin' first trumpet and the oth-, and Luke and Joe, that's what the trumpet section, that I remember real well, you know. And Louie was up there, sittin' up there, just sitting down and didn't, wasn't doing nothing, 'cause he didn't have no parts. I don't know if Louie could read then - I know, that I don't know nothin' about, see. It's just the parts for that he couldn't read, but even if he could have read he, they didn't…
